name: Knott's California Marketplace TGI Fridays Simply Grilled Chicken Breast or Sirloin Steak & Mashed Potatoes
brandOrRestaurant: TGI Fridays (California Marketplace · Outside Knott's Berry Farm Gate)
whyItWorks: Right outside the Knott's exit gate, TGI Fridays has a "Simply Grilled" section offering un-sauced grilled chicken breast, Atlantic salmon, or center-cut sirloin paired with cheddar mashed potatoes or jasmine rice.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Simply Grilled Chicken Breast, Salmon, or Sirloin with **NO Whiskey-Glaze** and **NO Cajun spice**, paired with jasmine white rice or mashed potatoes (take lactase for the potatoes).
watchOuts: Skip the loaded potato skins, buffalo wings, and garlic-butter broccoli
